_about: Sir John Edwin Sandys (1844-1922), Public Orator at Cambridge. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): A History of Classical Scholarship (Cambridge, 3 vols., 1903-1908) and A Short History of Classical Scholarship (1915), raw IA OCR. No uids minted. Round du (2026-10-23), raw IA: Demosthenes against Leptines (1890), Select Private Orations part II (with Paley, 1886; part I is on the f-a-paley shelf), Aristotle's Constitution of Athens (1893), An Easter Vacation in Greece (1887), Harvard Lectures on the Revival of Learning (1905). Not taken: his Bacchae (the open scans OCR its English as Greek letters) and Isocrates Ad Demonicum (same).
